Name: Painful Endurance
Description: You embrace the coming suffering to spread it further, like lighting yourself on fire to propagate the flame further. Your body ripples with cracks and gashes that are easily torn open, causing you to suffer 2 Bleed whenever you are hit with an attack. While Bleeding, you deal half your Bleed count’s worth of additional damage when you deal damage, to a maximum of +20. Any damage dealt this way is the same as the original attack’s.
